messages:
maria: Hey team, customer (AcmePayments) reporting streaming responses hang in their Next.js Edge function. They see the ReadableStream pause after ~2-4 chunks, then nothing. SDK v0.12.3 on their repo. Saying it worked earlier this week and broke after a deploy. Error looks like `ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED` in their logs.

devon: thanks — can you paste the minimal repro and browser vs edge differences? is this only Edge runtime?

maria: only in Edge (Vercel Edge runtime). Node serverless and hosted API fine. They repro with our example code:

maria: ```ts
const res = await client.stream.create({...});
const reader = res.body.getReader();
while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  if (done) break;
  console.log(new TextDecoder().decode(value));
}
```

maria: logs:
```
[INFO] request id=abc123 - open stream
[WARN] chunk 0 sent
[ERROR] stream paused unexpectedly, reader blocked - ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED
[DEBUG] reconnect scheduled after auth-rotate
```

sam: hmm. v0.12.3 is pretty old for Edge streaming; we shipped a fix for ReadableStream pause + SSE framing in 0.14.x. Could be a kernel selection change causing backpressure handling to differ.

devon: @maria can you ask for these details from the customer: Node runtime version (or Vercel edge runtime version), @redwood/sdk package version (exact), and whether they use any polyfills (eventsource, stream.Readable polyfills)? Also request a HAR or raw raw SSE payload if possible.

maria: asked. they sent this payload snippet (truncated):
```
event: message
data: {"id":"tok1","text":"hello"}


event: message
data: {"id":"tok2","text":"world"}


```

jong: two quick theories: 1) auth token rotation mid-stream triggers our client to attempt silent refresh and then the Edge runtime stream gets closed unexpectedly, 2) older SDK double-wraps the ReadableStream and the runtime's native stream gets garbage-collected causing ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED.

jong: Can you have them try: upgrade to @redwood/sdk@0.14.1 (edge streaming fixes), or as a workaround set `stream: false` to disable streaming and fall back to chunked polling.

maria: customer tried upgrade to 0.14.1 and still saw intermittent pauses, but frequency reduced. They also reported a billing spike during retries while stream was hanging. They want a root cause — suspect auth retries.

devon: note: there was a bug where auth rotation triggered a retry loop on reconnect that doubled requests if the initial stream didn't return a final event. We patched that in 0.14.2 — please ask them to try 0.14.2 and enable debug env var: `REDWOOD_DEBUG=stream,auth` and share the logs.

maria: forwarded instructions. quick troubleshooting tips I gave them: 1) pin SDK to 0.14.2, 2) ensure Vercel uses our recommended edge runtime (node 18 edge compat), 3) set short client-side retry/backoff, 4) add server-side idempotency token to avoid double-billing on retry. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1175 — Escalate to eng-runtime if customer sees >=2 outages or billing impact. (link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1175)

sam: I'll take this — assigning to eng-runtime. initial steps: reproduce on our internal Vercel Edge env using their minimal repo and our SDK pinned to 0.12.3 and 0.14.2. If repro, capture a nettrace and the full SSE frame stream to see if missing trailing newline is causing parser to wait.

devon: one more thing — add `Content-Type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8` check on the customer side. Some proxies strip that and our stream parser will buffer waiting for terminators.

maria: customer ran 0.14.2 + set Content-Type explicitly. They reported much better behavior for 6 hours then a single pause. Sent debug logs (redacted) including `auth: rotated token mid-stream` line at the same timestamp as the pause.

sam: that lines up with the auth-rotation retry bug. Eng-runtime: can you confirm a fix in 0.14.3 that defers token refresh until stream end or uses an out-of-band refresh? If yes we should recommend 0.14.3 and draft a KB for customers to avoid retries during active streams.

jong: confirmed — 0.14.3 has out-of-band refresh + safe retry gating. Backport scheduled for patch channel. We'll prepare a patch release and release notes.

maria: relaying to customer: ETA for patch?

jong: patch publish in 2h, eng will also push a short-run hotfix to the runtime to avoid immediate mid-stream disconnects.

maria: thanks — customer asked for temporary mitigation steps (short list). I'll send: pin to 0.14.2 + set idempotency header + set client-side retry window to 30s and enable REDWOOD_DEBUG. They were happy with that as interim.

devon: add to support KB: note about Edge runtimes being sensitive to polyfills and stream wrappers, and recommended SDK version matrix. I'll create a follow-up doc.

maria: closing loop with customer once patch is out. will update INC-2026-1175 with timeline.
